title: Validate pinned materialization before benchmark scoring
description: run-benchmark.ts currently treats any existing cache directory as materialized. Before scanning or scoring, verify that the cache is a valid Git checkout at the manifest commit, that every declared scope path exists with the expected file or directory kind, and that sparse-checkout state satisfies the manifest. Reuse the shared materialization validation contract rather than duplicating weaker checks. Fail with a clear remediation command when validation fails. Add tests for wrong HEAD, non-Git directory, missing included path, incomplete sparse patterns, and a valid pinned checkout. Metrics must never be produced from an unverified or partial cache.
